## Data

```{r}
feat <- read_csv(here::here(path_multilevel, "feat_model.csv")) |> 
  mutate(lapse = factor(lapse))

full_model <- read_rds(
  here::here(
    format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
    "model_multilevel_glmer_v2.rds"
  )
)
compact_model_glmer_files <- list.files(
  path = "~/Desktop/model_save/glmer",
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

compact_model_glm <- read_rds(
  here::here(
    format_path("risk/models/multilevel"),
    "model_multilevel_glm_v2.rds"
  )
)

aug_model_glmer_files <- list.files(
  path = "~/Desktop/model_save/glm",
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

## Analysis

### Full Model vs. Removal of Each Random Effect

```{r}
results <- map(
  compact_model_glmer_files,
  \(file) {
    
    message("Processing: ", basename(file))
    
    compact_model <- read_rds(file)

    anova(full_model, compact_model, test = "LRT") |> 
      as_tibble() |> 
      mutate(
        rand_effect = str_remove(basename(file), ".rds")
      )
    
  }
) |> 
  list_rbind()
```

### Compact Model (glm) vs. Each Random Effect Added

```{r}
results2 <- map(
  aug_model_glmer_files,
  \(file) {
    
    message("Processing: ", basename(file))
    
    aug_model <- read_rds(file)

    anova(aug_model, compact_model_glm, test = "LRT") |> 
      as_tibble() |> 
      mutate(
        rand_effect = str_remove(basename(file), ".rds")
      )
    
  }
) |> 
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
set.seed(1221)

B <- 1000

bootstrap_results <- map(
  aug_model_glmer_files,
  \(file) {
    
    message("Processing: ", basename(file))
    
    aug_model <- read_rds(file)
    
    lrt_boot <- replicate(B, {
      
      # simulate outcome under H0
      y_sim <- simulate(compact_model_glm, nsim = 1)[[1]]
      
      # refit GLM
      glm_sim <- update(
        compact_model_glm,
        lapse ~ .,
        data = transform(feat, lapse = y_sim)
      )
      
      # refit GLMM
      glmer_sim <- update(
        aug_model,
        data = transform(feat, lapse = y_sim)
      )
      
      2 * (
        as.numeric(logLik(glmer_sim)) -
        as.numeric(logLik(glm_sim))
      )
    })
    
    # observed LRT
    ll_glm   <- logLik(compact_model_glm)
    ll_glmer <- logLik(aug_model)
    
    lrt_obs <- 2 * (
      as.numeric(ll_glmer) -
      as.numeric(ll_glm)
    )
    
    tibble(
      rand_effect = str_remove(basename(file), "\\.rds$"),
      lrt_obs = lrt_obs,
      n_exceed = sum(lrt_boot >= lrt_obs),
      p_boot = (sum(lrt_boot >= lrt_obs) + 1) / (B + 1)
    )
  }
) |>
  list_rbind()
```
